description: This Python script sets up a file upload and analysis pipeline using Pipecat, Gemini API, and various transport configurations. It creates a sample text file, uploads it to Gemini, and manages a conversational pipeline that references the uploaded file, including event handling for client connections and disconnections.

classes.name: GeminiLiveLLMService
classes.description: A service class for interacting with Gemini's LLM API, supporting file uploads and other functionalities.

classes.name: Pipeline
classes.description: Represents the processing pipeline for handling input, context, and output.

classes.name: PipelineRunner
classes.description: Manages execution of the pipeline, including signal handling.

classes.name: PipelineTask
classes.description: Defines a specific task with a pipeline and parameters, including event handling.

classes.name: LLMContext
classes.description: Holds the context data for the language model, including references to uploaded files.

classes.name: LLMContextAggregatorPair
classes.description: Creates a pair of context aggregators for managing conversation flow.

methods.name: create_sample_file
methods.description: Creates a temporary sample text file for testing the Gemini File API.

methods.name: run_bot
methods.description: Sets up and runs the conversational pipeline, including file upload, context creation, and event handling.

methods.name: bot
methods.description: Main entry point that initializes transport and starts the bot process.
